text: The Patriots are heading to Chicago for Thursday Night Football against the Bears shorthanded and looking to build on their win over the Jets, but the injury report reads like a casualty list: guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown are out due to hamstring and knee injuries respectively, cornerbacks Carlton Davis III and Karon Prunty won't make the trip due to neck and hamstring issues, and Romeo Doubs has been placed on injured reserve after suffering a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch in the Jets game, leaving the receiving corps thin just as A.J. Brown is still shaking off the rust from a four-week absence that saw him drop a career-high three passes in his return Sunday. The matchup itself carries intrigue beyond the injury complications: Drake Maye and Bears QB Caleb Williams have known each other for years as part of the same draft class and attended the same football camps growing up, setting up a fascinating generational quarterback duel on a short week in the Windy City. With the Patriots needing their stars to perform and their lineup decimated by injuries on both the offensive and defensive lines, this Thursday night battle will test just how deep the roster really runs.
